basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 24-year-old exploring the vast world of Reddit. Originally from Portland, I'm currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I've got a keen interest in psychedelics and how they intersect with personal growth and self-discovery. I also enjoy spending time outdoors, embracing my naturalist side at local nudist spots. My online hours are typically late at night, as I'm a bit of a night owl. Currently single, I'm focusing on personal development and exploring my gender identity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from self-teaching and personal experiences. I've spent a lot of time researching psychedelics and their effects, both through academic articles and firsthand experience. My design skills are honed through online tutorials and hands-on projects.
